visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a white t-shirt stands in an indoor living room. He brings his hand close to the camera, palm facing forward, then waves slightly while looking directly into the lens with a smiling expression. The background features warm indoor lighting and household furniture. (2) The man shifts his focus to his hand and mouth. He opens his mouth slightly and touches his tongue with his index finger. He begins to pull his hand away while his tongue stays attached to his finger, creating a visual effect of being stuck. His facial expressions are exaggerated, showing feigned distress and effort to pull them apart. (3) He continues the comedic performance, demonstrating that his other fingers do not stick to his tongue by touching them and pulling away easily. He then touches his index finger to his tongue again, and it appears to 'stick' instantly, causing him to widen his eyes and lean back. (4) He holds up his hand to reveal black text written on his index finger. He smiles broadly at the camera, gesturing with his hand and nodding as if revealing a joke. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame throughout the sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and a friendly tone, greeting the audience with a standard New Year's wish. The vocal delivery is clear with a moderate pitch and slightly fast tempo. (2) A wet, percussive smacking sound occurs as if skin is touching a moist surface. The speaker's voice transitions to an exaggerated cry of distress, shouting in a high-arousal, high-pitched tone that something is stuck. (3) The speaker laughs mid-sentence, shifting the tone to humorous and self-deprecating. He continues to explain a strange phenomenon with high pitch variability, alternating between conversational speech and mock-panicked exclamations. (4) The speaker reveals the punchline of his joke with a playful, laughing tone. He repeats a punny phrase multiple times, slowing down his speech rate to emphasize the play on words between 'tongue sticking' and the 'Year of the Snake'. The recording ends with a cheerful sign-off.
